observations.claim: The official EoH generated valid priority functions, including best-fit style residual-capacity ranking and alternative residual/target rules. The first-round generated candidates were valid, but the baseline remained the incumbent at mean relative gap 0.0.

The first round completed 10 evaluator attempts: one baseline and nine generated evaluations, with no seed reevaluation or repair. Some generated code hashes repeated, so generated diversity was partial.

hypotheses.claim: The mini benchmark saturates at zero relative gap for several valid strategies, so the next round is useful for wiring and inheritance validation rather than an optimization claim.

next_search_advice.direction: Use the verified first-round population as the next-round seed set and let EoH explore a structurally distinct priority rule while preserving the interface.
